World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) a general air-exposure food-preservation trial with an equipment-free whole-food mode, parameterized by an owned food stack, quantity, an accessible placement or existing support and start/inspect/turn/stop modes; it must reuse any equivalent handler, integrate a deterministic drying, rewetting and contamination update with the existing decay and, where required properties are unavailable, deliver tracked intact-food exposure with a decay comparison and preservation unverified, without invented water loss, shelf-life extension, safety, free equipment or reward. Registry check: the ex19 scope installs only foundation-forest, foundation-open and the expression foundation, none of which implements continuing exposure; no earlier exposure or drying package could be reused unchanged (ex14 controlled-food-processing-trial@1 has learning 3 and states that no food moisture model exists, which is false here; ex14 air-dry-food@1 is a first release that reports the missing model; ex10 measured-food-preservation@1 and the collective-ex12 root and small drying packages are bound to their tray, sheet and root representations and scopes). Implemented: a new package food-air-exposure-trial@1 (scope long-ex19, built by a reusable foodAirExposurePackage(id, scope) factory) with a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation (foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterExpose and foodWaterRead, with the unchanged ex10 exchange and its decay integration in the environment) and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers (workCreate, workPay, workAllocations, workReserve, workStop), openRemember and base pickup. Modes and costs: start (one round, 1 + 0.5 energy per exposed whole unit, paid through workPay) separates whole units of the actor's own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented) and lays them unowned on a ground footprint within hand reach (default the actor's position) or on an existing reachable object marked as a food surface, after the representation's real checks (inside the world, firm ordinary ground rather than water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, one sample per surface); an optional controlQuantity from the same stack stays carried and reserved in ordinary handling; inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, within reach of the batch) records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now, decay per round for batch and control, their difference and rain rounds as an unverified personal record; stop (one round, no energy) settles the trial, releases the control once and leaves the batch lying, to be taken back with base pickup at its own cost; every failed precondition throws before any charge, so nothing is spent. Effects: the batch receives the representation's water record and then follows its unchanged per-round rules: whole food loses no water, rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water, and decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset, so no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached and all three stay unverified; nutrition, toxicity and solids are unchanged; food quantity is conserved across parent, batch and control. reviews.specification:
General operation: prepare and expose food, parameterized by owned input stack IDs, quantity, preparation mode, toolId, supportId, location, optional control IDs and optional measurement instrument IDs. Modes are prepare/start, inspect, stop and resume; unsupported material/method combinations fail explicitly. The smallest initial executable method is thin-section preparation of represented roots or berries followed by passive air exposure on a real suitable food surface. Whole-food comparison remains available through the existing food-air-exposure-trial implementation, not a duplicate invention. No heat, fire, equipment fabrication or food-safety certification is included.
REFERENCES AND REUSE: Reuse food-air-exposure-trial for trial identity, reservations, placement/reach checks, control release, elapsed-time records and termination; reuse the existing food decay and preservationPhysics version-1 audit state for food composition and weather integration. Record these dependencies and changed prepared-food behavior in the implementation. navigate, pickup and probe retain their own contracts and costs; this operation does not silently execute them. The fragment item-13-wren-127:air-exposure is incomplete evidence; do not manufacture its missing pages. The applicant reports the eight-round negative comparison, not a demonstrated preservation effect. Current possible inputs are item-22-wren-250, item-5-wren-49 and item-13-wren-128, each one root with decay 22.47744171 at this packet's snapshot; revalidate live state before action. The interface must accept other eligible actors and items, not hard-code these instances.
PREREQUISITES: Living participant, completed individual learning, sufficient energy, exact owned unreserved food quantities, reach to food/tool/support, and permission to use any non-owned equipment. Preparation requires an actual cutting implement whose geometry, material, edge and condition support the selected operation, and an actual stable food-contact surface with sufficient area and a recorded contamination condition. A sharp stone, cleanliness, suitable weather and support capacity cannot be assumed. Tool and surface qualification use observed properties and implemented physical checks, not an invented inventory tag alone. Missing checks/mechanisms go to this same development handoff. No tool or support is currently established, so preparation is presently blocked, not rejected forever. An exposed whole root or nearby plant is not a cutting tool or measuring device. Basic visual observation can establish only visible changes. Numerical mass comparison additionally requires an actual usable balance or equivalent instrument with represented resolution and calibration; none is established. This prerequisite must be stated before promising numerical water-loss observations.
COSTS AND WORK: Study requires 4 ordinary world rounds, 0.5 energy per completed round, no consumed study materials and no inventory grants. Preparation/start accepts at most one original whole food unit per work round; larger requests proceed as serial units. Each unit costs one round and 1.5 energy, plus the actual food transferred into prepared portions, all offcuts and any recorded tool wear. A control reserved from an owned stack is not consumed or duplicated. Reuse the existing trial's whole-unit quantity and placement accounting where applicable. Surface area and permitted portion geometry must be checked against actual support capacity before charging. Placement is part of that unit's start work only if the chosen support is already in reach; travel is separate. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy for local visual observations and trial records. An instrument reading, if supported, costs an additional round and 0.5 energy per sample or control weighed, requires that instrument in reach and records its uncertainty. Consumable tests are unavailable until their actual materials and method are supplied; probe's paid sample consumption cannot be relabeled as a free measurement. Stop costs one round and no energy. Resume costs one round and 0.2 energy to revalidate/reposition surviving portions without cutting them again. All action preconditions are checked before charges. Drying has no guaranteed completion time: every world round of exposure advances real food/weather processes without free active work, while ordinary hunger and other world processes continue.
PHYSICS AND CONSERVATION: Initial splitting partitions the original edible dry matter, water, nutrients, toxins and decay history among retained portions and explicit offcuts; the original stack is debited exactly once. Offcuts remain real items or recorded waste, not extra edible output. Decay age is never reset. Cutting changes represented geometry and exposed area, not food quantity or nutrition by fiat. Version-1 assumed initial root/berry water fractions remain assumptions in internal audit state, not measured discoveries. Implement passive drying as a bounded moisture transfer driven by actual ambient temperature, humidity/evaporative demand, airflow, exposed geometry and exposure time; removal cannot exceed available transferable water, and absent a valid driving gradient there is no evaporation. Rain or wet contact may instead add actual environmental water. The handoff must bind this to explicit executable equations, units and coefficients consistent with the existing weather and food state before enabling prepared drying. Do not substitute a fixed percentage per round or a successful animation for the missing mechanism. Vapor leaves to the environment; runoff, detached matter, spilled material and any other modeled losses have separate ledger entries. Nutrients and toxins remain in retained matter unless an implemented process actually transfers or changes them. Reduced water may increase concentration; it never multiplies total nutrients or removes toxicity. Retain ordinary decay unless the existing physical model has a separately implemented moisture-dependent decay effect. Any such effect requires explicit code and must not retroactively rewrite the failed whole-root trial. Preservation and microbiological safety remain unverified.
EVIDENCE AND PRODUCTS: Produce identifiable prepared food portions, offcuts where any, a real exposure process and paid observation records, not a guaranteed dried ration. Record original source/lot, exact participants and IDs, preparation geometry/method, surface, tool, starting conditions, observation times, environmental exposure and control history. Prefer a same-stack untreated control when available; separate lots must be labeled confounded, not silently treated as matched. Each reading states whether it is visual, instrument-measured or an internal model assumption. Visual shriveling and absence of visible spoilage cannot establish water quantity, lack of spoilage or safety. Instrumental mass loss alone does not uniquely identify water loss: record rain, shedding, runoff, handling and instrument uncertainty and report residual ambiguity, including possible spoilage losses. A quantitative attribution to water requires an actual validated measurement method that separates those losses; otherwise report mass change only. A useful precursor may therefore prepare and expose food and record qualified visual observations, while numerical water attribution remains blocked on equipment/method. Decay comparisons use only the established trial inspection semantics and are labeled as model decay readings, not a new microbial test. No hidden food totals, local resources or future weather are disclosed to Wren.
LIFECYCLE: Keep per-unit committed work progress. A unit commits only when its work round completes; interruption before commitment charges only elapsed study/work actually performed and does not create prepared output. Already committed cuts, wear, spent energy and elapsed aging remain. Resume rechecks the surviving inputs and prerequisites and continues only unfinished work; committed preparation is never repeated or charged twice. Stopping or cancellation ends supervision and releases reserved controls once, leaving real food and offcuts at their actual locations; recovery uses pickup separately. Food left exposed continues its physical processes even without an open trial. Removing portions updates quantities; loss of all portions terminates the trial. Partial theft or removal does not clone replacement food. Death cancels pending work, releases control reservations and leaves material according to ordinary death/possession rules; it does not halt environmental drying or decay. Invalid requests have no charges; committed work has no energy, time, material or wear refund. No refund resets food age.
MAINTENANCE AND EXECUTION: Monitor real support condition, contact contamination, tool wear, obstruction and weather at each affected step. An unsuitable or broken support/tool prevents further affected work; only actual existing repair or cleaning methods may restore it, at their own costs. No automatic cleaning, sheltering, turning, fuel replenishment, retrieval or participant cooperation occurs. Other participants must independently communicate, consent where needed and act. Established checks, transfers, work progress, drying updates and reward deduplication execute in code after implementation, not through repeated model approval. The handoff must resolve the stated physics and measurement dependencies before advertising those modes as executable; it may enable the explicitly limited precursor first without implying the full trial succeeded.
